description: Poisson GLM + NB, r по лигам (выбор на 2025/26)
hypothesis: The corner distribution of this variant gives a lower log score of total corners and a lower mean log loss of over/under 8.5/9.5/10.5 than production (XGBoost + NB r=71.1), without lowering Main ROI.
primary_metric: paired mean log score of total corners vs production (lower is better)
secondary: Main ROI paired vs Baseline B (close and t09)
minimum_forward_sample: 1500 played matches with corner statistics (≈ 3 months)
